name: Advanced Circuitry International
old_description: At Advanced Circuitry International we’ve been manufacturing a wide array of Antenna PCB’s since 2011.
about:
Advanced Circuitry International was founded in 1992 in Duluth, Georgia, as an independently owned manufacturer of high-reliability RF/microwave and antenna printed circuit boards. The company began with a focus on aerospace, defense, telecommunications, and medical device markets, building expertise in exotic substrates such as Teflon and ceramics.

Today the company operates a 70,000-square-foot facility and is expanding into an additional 50,000 square feet. Its capabilities span RF/microwave PCBs, antenna PCBs, large-format boards up to 24 by 102 inches, multilayer constructions, rapid prototyping, and full assembly of RF/microwave and antenna sub-systems. The shop also provides design-for-manufacturability assistance, impedance modeling, in-process and final inspection testing, and a logistics program that stocks laminate materials and finished goods for qualified customers.

Advanced Circuitry serves a global base of OEMs and EMS providers across land, sea, air, and space applications. Specific markets include 5G infrastructure, base stations, GPS, microwave communications, small cells, automotive electronics, and marine systems. The company's customer list includes notable original equipment manufacturers and electronics manufacturing services firms worldwide.

The company differentiates itself through its AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015 certifications, ITAR registration, and a stated "zero defect" quality policy. It emphasizes control of passive intermodulation (PIM) for low-PIM applications, rapid turnaround supported by a large inventory of RF materials, and the ability to produce exceptionally large antenna structures on a wide range of high-frequency laminates.
